expectations.text: 输出包含完整的模块化蓝图文件集
expectations.evidence: 输出含 PRD、SPEC、3 个领域 specs、DESIGN、ARCHITECTURE、SECURITY、DEPLOY、ENGINEERING、CLAUDE 与 AGENTS，共 12 份蓝图文档。

expectations.text: PRD 与 SPEC 使用稳定 ID 并建立追踪
expectations.evidence: PRD 使用 PRD-SCHED/BOOK/COACH/ACCESS IDs；SPEC.md 逐项映射到 SPEC IDs、设计、架构和测试状态。

expectations.text: 领域规格包含 Given/When/Then 和验收方法
expectations.evidence: scheduling.md、booking.md、coach-workspace.md 均包含 GIVEN/WHEN/THEN 场景和 Acceptance method。

expectations.text: 未知项被登记并阻断相应就绪度
expectations.evidence: TBD-* 记录 owner、decision-by 与 blocked gate；SPEC.md 的三个 readiness gate 均为 blocked。

expectations.text: 未无依据采用复杂架构或中间件
expectations.evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md 采用 provisional 模块化单体与关系库，明确无证据时不引入 Redis、队列、搜索、微服务或 Kubernetes。

needs_review: All three readiness gates remain blocked pending product decisions.

eval_feedback.overall: The assertions distinguish structural traceability and decision honesty from general planning prose.
